notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): UIDropDownMenu.xml is Benilla's shared dropdown kit (capsule template, row template, 2-level list, MENU displayMode, hover auto-close) - framework plumbing, not a surface. MSUI has no transcription of the kit and none of its consumers currently use a vanilla-styled dropdown (settings use ImGui combos; the world map / trainer / tradeskill filter dropdowns that would consume it are themselves absent - tracked as gaps on those entries). Realized, where needed, through MSUI's own ImGui widgets.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: If Nico rules that consumer surfaces (world-map zone pickers, trainer/tradeskill filters, unit-popup menus) must wear the vanilla dropdown art, MSUI will need a shared vanilla dropdown widget; today nothing renders the UI-DropDownMenu art family.
